title: Audio-Technica VM95SH / Thorens TD 160 Super / SME III — 1 kHz Reference Check
source_report_title: Audio Technica VM95SH - Thorens TD160 Super - SME III - Art Preamp

harmonic_reliability.quality_note: Steady during recording. Suitable for setup guidance.

interpretation.summary: Groove Scope made it easy to improve the azimuth from a much poorer starting point. After adjustment, this setup measured 17.7 dB average channel separation at 1 kHz. The Audio-Technica VM95SH used in the session had a bent cantilever, so the cartridge readings apply to this compromised specimen. The Thorens averaged 33.29 RPM, and both Rotation Fingerprints showed a speed pattern that repeated each turn and warrants further investigation.
interpretation.recommendation: The report recommends checking routing and gain and repeating the capture to investigate the 2.90 dB channel level difference. The repeated speed pattern gives the measurer a reason to investigate the Thorens' rotation further.
interpretation.alignment_context: The measurer reports that Groove Scope made the azimuth adjustment straightforward and the starting point was substantially worse. The supplied capture documents the final results only. The directional crosstalk difference of 1.45 dB is separate from the signal channel balance of +2.90 dB (L−R).
interpretation.rotation_context: Both speed fingerprints show a slower portion and a faster portion recurring at similar relative angles over eight revolutions. The mechanical cause remains open.

session_observations.source: Measurer account supplied with publication request
session_observations.cartridge_condition: The VM95SH used in this capture had a bent cantilever, per the measurer. The results describe this compromised specimen.

azimuth_adjustment.result: Azimuth improved from a much poorer starting point, per the measurer.

session_observations.separate_trackability_article: A separate article will cover the ultra-low-mass SME III's 90 µm trackability result measured with Groove Scope Studio.
